senses.zh: 这、那（用于双方明确所指的事物）
senses.definition: used before a noun when the reader or listener knows which person or thing you mean
senses.example: Please close the door.

senses.definition: have a particular identity, quality, or position; exist
senses.example: My sister is a teacher.

senses.zh: 用于进行时或被动语态
senses.definition: used with an -ing form for an action in progress, or a past participle for something done to the subject
senses.example: They are making dinner.

senses.definition: joins words or ideas, or shows that one action follows another
senses.example: She opened the door and went inside.

senses.definition: shows a link such as belonging, a part of a whole, an amount, or what something contains
senses.example: He gave me a glass of water.

senses.definition: used before a singular noun for one person or thing not already identified, or to mean each
senses.example: We need a chair for our guest.

senses.definition: inside a place, within a period, or wearing particular clothes
senses.example: My keys are in the bag.

senses.definition: inside or towards the inside of a place; at home or at work
senses.example: Come in and sit down.

senses.definition: fashionable or popular at a particular time
senses.example: Bright colours are in this summer.

senses.definition: shows a destination, a person receiving something, a limit, or a link between things
senses.example: I sent a message to my brother.

senses.zh: 用于动词原形前，构成不定式
senses.definition: used before the basic form of a verb, often to show a purpose or follow another verb
senses.example: I want to learn English.

senses.definition: own or experience something; eat or drink something; do an activity; need to do something with 'to'
senses.example: We have breakfast at seven.

senses.definition: used with a past participle to link an earlier action or state to a later time
senses.example: I have finished my homework.

senses.zh: 它；用于谈论时间、天气或情况
senses.definition: refers to a thing, animal, or situation; also introduces statements about time or weather
senses.example: I found your bag and put it on the chair.

senses.definition: the word a speaker uses as the subject when talking about themselves
senses.example: I walk to work every day.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: points to a particular person or thing that is farther away or has already been mentioned
senses.example: Who lives in that house?

senses.definition: stands for a person, thing, or idea being pointed out; also links a noun to information about it
senses.example: That is a good idea.

senses.zh: 引出所说、所想或所知的内容
senses.definition: introduces a statement after words about saying, thinking, knowing, or feeling
senses.example: I know that you are busy.

senses.definition: to the degree being discussed or shown
senses.example: The test was not that difficult.

notes: 原主词性 adj. 的指示限定用法改为现代语法标签 det.，不删除其用法。

senses.definition: shows a purpose, a person helped, a period of time, a reason, or what something is exchanged for
senses.example: I bought these flowers for my mother.

senses.definition: introduces the reason for what has just been said, mainly in formal writing
senses.example: We stayed inside, for the storm was getting worse.

senses.definition: refers to the person or people being spoken to, or to people in general
senses.example: Can you help me with this bag?

senses.definition: refers to a male person already mentioned or understood
senses.example: My brother is here, and he wants to see you.

senses.definition: together with someone, using something, having a feature, or feeling something towards someone
senses.example: She cut the paper with scissors.

senses.definition: touching a surface; during a particular day; about a subject; using a device or service
senses.example: The meeting is on Friday.

senses.definition: working or operating; continuing an action; moving forward
senses.example: The lights are still on.

senses.definition: happening or still planned to happen
senses.example: Is the match still on tonight?

senses.definition: perform an action or task; be enough or suitable for a purpose
senses.example: I do the cooking and he washes the dishes.

senses.definition: helps form questions and negative statements, or adds emphasis to another verb
senses.example: Do you live near here?

senses.definition: express something in words; give information; ask someone to imagine a possibility
senses.example: The sign says the shop closes at six.

senses.definition: a chance or right to express an opinion or help make a decision
senses.example: Everyone should have a say in the plan.

senses.definition: points to a person or thing nearby, just mentioned, or connected with the present time
senses.example: This book is easy to read.

senses.definition: stands for a nearby thing, a present situation, or something you are introducing
senses.example: This is my sister.

senses.definition: to the amount or degree being shown
senses.example: I did not know the bag was this heavy.

senses.zh: 他们、她们、它们；泛指性别未知的人
senses.definition: refers to people or things already mentioned, or one person whose gender is unknown or not stated
senses.example: The children are outside because they want to play.

senses.definition: shows a place, a particular time, a target, a rate, or an activity someone is doing
senses.example: Meet me at the station at six.

senses.definition: joins ideas that differ or introduces something that corrects or limits what was said
senses.example: The room is small but comfortable.

senses.definition: except for someone or something
senses.example: Everyone but Tom arrived on time.

senses.definition: refers to the speaker together with one or more other people
senses.example: We eat dinner together every evening.

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a male person already mentioned
senses.example: His bike is outside.

senses.definition: stands for something belonging to a male person
senses.example: My coat is blue, but his is black.

senses.definition: shows where something starts, comes from, is made from, or is caused by
senses.example: The train from London arrives at noon.

senses.definition: makes a statement negative or says that something is untrue
senses.example: I am not hungry.

senses.definition: shows who does something, a method, a nearby position, or the latest time something can happen
senses.example: Please finish the work by Friday.

senses.definition: past a place or near someone or something
senses.example: A bus went by as we waited.

senses.definition: refers to a female person already mentioned or understood
senses.example: My sister is a doctor, and she works nearby.

senses.definition: shows a choice between possibilities, or introduces what happens if something is not done
senses.example: Would you like tea or coffee?

senses.definition: shows the job, role, or purpose of someone or something
senses.example: She works as a nurse.

senses.definition: introduces a time, a reason, or the way something happens
senses.example: As it was raining, we stayed inside.

senses.definition: used in comparisons to show an equal degree or amount
senses.example: My bag is as heavy as yours.

senses.definition: asks about something unknown or stands for the thing that someone means
senses.example: What did you buy?

senses.definition: asks which kind of thing is meant or introduces a strong feeling about something
senses.example: What time does the shop open?

senses.definition: move to another place, leave, happen in a particular way, change state, or work
senses.example: We go to the park after school.

senses.definition: an attempt at something or a turn to do it
senses.example: Can I have a go on your bike?

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: belonging to people or things mentioned, or to one person whose gender is not stated
senses.example: The children put on their coats.

notes: 所有格置于名词前，标签由 pron. 明确为 det.。

senses.definition: shows ability, permission, or something that is possible
senses.example: I can swim, but I cannot dive.

senses.definition: a metal container used for food, drinks, or other things
senses.example: She opened a can of soup.

senses.definition: put food into sealed containers so it can be kept for a long time
senses.example: The factory cans tomatoes in summer.

senses.zh: 谁；引导有关人的关系从句
senses.definition: asks which person is meant or adds information about a person
senses.example: Who left this bag here?

senses.zh: 得到；拿来；到达；变得；明白
senses.definition: receive or obtain something, fetch it, arrive somewhere, become a state, or understand
senses.example: It gets cold here at night.

senses.definition: introduces a condition or asks whether something is true
senses.example: If it rains, we will stay home.

senses.zh: 将会；会（假设）；愿意；过去常常
senses.definition: shows an imagined result, a polite request, a future seen from the past, or a repeated past action
senses.example: I would walk to work if I lived closer.

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a female person
senses.example: Her mother is waiting outside.

senses.definition: refers to a female person as the object of a verb or after a word such as 'to' or 'with'
senses.example: I called her yesterday.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: the whole number or amount of something
senses.example: All the windows are open.

senses.definition: everyone or everything in a group
senses.example: All of us enjoyed the meal.

senses.definition: completely or to a great degree
senses.example: Your clothes are all wet.

notes: 原 adj. 所有的 用法改为 det.，另补代词和副词。

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with the speaker
senses.example: My phone is in my bag.

senses.definition: create something, cause a result, force someone to act, or earn money
senses.example: This song makes me happy.

senses.definition: the company or type that a product belongs to
senses.example: What make of car do you drive?

senses.definition: on the subject of something, connected with it, or in different parts of a place
senses.example: We talked about our weekend plans.

senses.zh: 大约；到处；即将（be about to）
senses.definition: approximately; in various places; close to doing something in the phrase 'be about to'
senses.example: The walk takes about twenty minutes.

senses.definition: have information or understanding; be familiar with someone or something; have learned how to do something
senses.example: Do you know how to use this machine?

senses.zh: 将、会；愿意；表示请求或意愿
senses.definition: shows a future action, a decision, willingness, or a request
senses.example: I will call you tomorrow.

senses.definition: the strength or wish to do something; a legal document saying who receives property after someone dies
senses.example: She has a strong will to succeed.

senses.zh: 凭意志促成；立遗嘱赠与
senses.definition: try to make something happen by strong wishing; arrange to leave property to someone after death
senses.example: He willed himself to stay awake.

senses.definition: towards a higher position; out of bed; to a higher amount; completely in some verb phrases
senses.example: Please stand up when your name is called.

senses.definition: towards a higher point or further along a road or river
senses.example: We walked up the hill.

senses.definition: awake and out of bed; higher than before; finished when talking about an allowed time
senses.example: Our time is up, so we must stop.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: the number before two, or a single person or thing
senses.example: We have one spare chair.

senses.zh: 一个（代替前述名词）；泛指人
senses.definition: stands for a person or thing of a kind already mentioned; can also mean people in general
senses.example: This cup is broken; please use the other one.

senses.definition: the written number 1, or a coin or note worth a single unit of money
senses.example: Write a one in the first box.

notes: 将数字主词性从 n. 调整为 num.，保留名词用法。

senses.definition: what is measured in hours or years; a particular moment, occasion, or period
senses.example: I do not have time to cook tonight.

senses.definition: measure how long something takes or choose when something should happen
senses.example: Use your phone to time the race.

senses.zh: 在那里；到那里；在那方面
senses.definition: in or to that place; at that point in an activity or discussion
senses.example: Put your bag over there.

senses.zh: 用于 there is/are 等存在句
senses.definition: used before a form of 'be' to introduce something that exists or happens
senses.example: There are two cups on the table.

senses.definition: a period of twelve months, usually 365 days; also a school or business period of about this length
senses.example: We moved here last year.

senses.definition: to that degree; in that way; used to avoid repeating an idea or to show the same is true
senses.example: The soup was so hot that I could not eat it.

senses.definition: introduces a result or purpose
senses.example: It was late, so we took a taxi.

senses.definition: have an opinion, use your mind to consider something, remember, or plan
senses.example: I think this is the right road.

senses.zh: 思考（尤用于 have a think）
senses.definition: a short period spent considering something
senses.example: Let me have a think before I answer.

senses.definition: asks about a time or links a time to something that happens then
senses.example: When does the train leave?

senses.definition: introduces the time or situation in which something happens
senses.example: Call me when you arrive.

senses.definition: asks someone to choose or identify something from a known group
senses.example: Which coat is yours?

senses.zh: 哪一个；引导物的关系从句
senses.definition: stands for a choice from a group, or adds information about a thing or situation
senses.example: We visited a park which has a small lake.

senses.definition: refers to people or things as the object of a verb or after a word such as 'with'
senses.example: The children are hungry, so I made them sandwiches.

senses.definition: an amount or number that is not exact; a person or thing not identified
senses.example: We need some milk.

senses.zh: 一些人、一些事物；一部分
senses.definition: an amount or number of people or things, but not all of them
senses.example: There is cake left if you want some.

senses.definition: approximately, used before a number
senses.example: Some fifty people came to the meeting.

senses.definition: the word a speaker uses for themselves as the object of a verb or after a word such as 'to'
senses.example: Please send me the address.

senses.definition: human beings as a group; the members of a country or a group sharing a language and culture
senses.example: Many people use this park every day.

senses.definition: live in a place or fill it with people
senses.example: The island was first peopled thousands of years ago.

senses.zh: 拿；带；接受；乘坐；花费；服用
senses.definition: pick up or carry something; accept it; use transport; need time; put medicine into your body
senses.example: It takes twenty minutes to walk home.

senses.definition: someone's way of understanding something; a single recording of a film scene
senses.example: What is your take on the new plan?

senses.definition: outside or away from home; towards the outside; no longer burning; completely in some verb phrases
senses.example: We went out for dinner.

senses.zh: 不在家的；出局的；已公布的
senses.definition: away from home; no longer in a game; available or made public
senses.example: The exam results are out today.

senses.zh: 进入；变成；撞上；对……有兴趣
senses.definition: towards the inside; changing to a new state; against something; interested in something
senses.example: She poured the water into a glass.

senses.definition: a very short time ago; only; exactly; by a small amount
senses.example: I have just finished dinner.

senses.definition: fair and morally right
senses.example: Everyone deserves a just decision.

senses.zh: 看见；明白；会见；观看；确保
senses.definition: notice with your eyes, understand, meet someone, watch something, or make sure something happens
senses.example: I can see the sea from my window.

senses.definition: refers to a male person as the object of a verb or after a word such as 'to'
senses.example: I met him at the station.

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with the person or people being spoken to
senses.example: Is this your bag?

senses.definition: move towards a person or place, arrive, happen, have an origin, or reach a state
senses.example: Can you come to my house tomorrow?

senses.zh: 过去能；可能；可以（委婉请求）
senses.definition: shows past ability, a possibility, or a polite request or suggestion
senses.example: Could you open the window, please?

senses.definition: at the present time or without any more delay
senses.example: I am busy now, but I can call you later.

senses.definition: because a new situation has become true
senses.example: Now that we are home, we can rest.

senses.definition: introduces the second person or thing in a comparison
senses.example: My brother is taller than me.

senses.definition: introduces a clause giving the other side of a comparison
senses.example: The work took longer than we expected.

senses.definition: enjoy or feel positive about someone or something; want something in polite requests with 'would'
senses.example: I like walking by the river.

senses.definition: similar to someone or something; used to introduce an example
senses.example: This fruit tastes like a pear.

senses.definition: something you enjoy; a sign on a website showing that you approve of a post
senses.example: Tell us about your likes and dislikes.

senses.definition: in the same way that, used mainly in informal speech
senses.example: Nobody cooks like my grandmother does.

senses.definition: having similar qualities or features
senses.example: The boxes contain like objects.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: different from the one mentioned, additional, or remaining
senses.example: Do you have any other questions?

senses.definition: a different or remaining person or thing; people or things besides those mentioned
senses.example: One shoe is here, but where is the other?

notes: 原译 从前的 不适合作基础义；the other day 单独作为搭配保留。

senses.definition: asks about a method, condition, amount, or degree
senses.example: How do you get to work?

senses.definition: after that; at that time; in that case
senses.example: Wash the vegetables, then cut them into small pieces.

senses.definition: holding a role or being true at the time being discussed
senses.example: The then manager approved the plan.

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a thing or animal already mentioned
senses.example: The dog is sleeping in its bed.

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with the speaker and one or more other people
senses.example: Our house is near the school.

senses.definition: the number after one and before three
senses.example: We need two tickets, please.

senses.definition: greater in number or amount; additional
senses.example: We need more time to finish.

senses.definition: an additional or greater amount or number
senses.example: Would you like some more?

senses.definition: to a greater degree, more often, or for a longer time
senses.example: Please speak more slowly.

senses.definition: points to two or more people or things nearby or currently being discussed
senses.example: These shoes are too small.

senses.definition: stands for two or more people or things nearby or being discussed
senses.example: These are my favourite photos.

senses.definition: wish to have or do something; need something
senses.example: I want to learn how to swim.

senses.definition: a lack of something necessary; something that someone needs or desires
senses.example: The project failed for want of money.

senses.zh: 方法；道路；方向；习惯；方面
senses.definition: a method of doing something, a route or direction, a usual behaviour, or an aspect
senses.example: What is the easiest way to get to the station?

senses.definition: by a large amount or distance, used informally for emphasis
senses.example: This bag is way too heavy.

senses.definition: direct your eyes, try to find something, seem a certain way, or face a direction
senses.example: You look tired today.

senses.definition: an act of using your eyes; an expression on a face; the appearance or style of something
senses.example: Let me have a look at your photo.

senses.definition: coming before all others in time or order; most important
senses.example: This is my first visit to London.

senses.definition: before anyone or anything else; for the earliest time
senses.example: Wash your hands first.

senses.zh: 首例；首次发生的事；第一名
senses.definition: something never done before, or the top position in an event
senses.example: The new service is a first for our town.

senses.definition: in addition to what has already been mentioned
senses.example: She speaks French and also knows some Spanish.

senses.zh: 新的；新近的；初次接触的
senses.definition: made, found, or started recently; different from before; not yet familiar to someone
senses.example: I am new to this job, so I ask many questions.

senses.definition: introduces the reason why something happens or is true
senses.example: I stayed home because I was ill.

senses.definition: a period of twenty-four hours, the hours of daylight, or a particular period in life
senses.example: We spent the day at the beach.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: do something with a tool, material, or method; take an amount of a resource
senses.example: Can I use your pen?

senses.definition: the act of doing something with an object or resource; a purpose or practical value
senses.example: This box has many possible uses.

notes: use 的动词读 /juːz/，名词读 /juːs/；主程序应按词性区分音标。

senses.definition: not any, not a single one, or not allowed
senses.example: There is no milk in the fridge.

senses.definition: gives a negative answer or makes a comparison negative
senses.example: No, I have not seen your phone.

senses.definition: an answer or vote that refuses or disagrees
senses.example: We received a clear no from the owner.

senses.zh: 成年男子；人类（传统泛称）
senses.definition: an adult male person; also a traditional general word for human beings
senses.example: A man helped us carry the bags.

senses.definition: provide the people needed to operate or watch a place or piece of equipment
senses.example: Two volunteers manned the information desk.

senses.definition: discover something by searching or by chance; learn a fact; have an opinion based on experience
senses.example: I find this book easy to read.

senses.definition: something useful or interesting that has been discovered
senses.example: This old table was a great find.

senses.zh: 在这里；到这里；此时、此处
senses.definition: in or to this place; at this point in an activity or discussion
senses.example: Please sit here next to me.

senses.zh: 东西；事情；情况；个人物品
senses.definition: an object, action, idea, situation, or item belonging to someone
senses.example: I have a few things to do before lunch.

senses.zh: 给；提供；使产生；举办；让步
senses.definition: let someone receive something, provide a service, cause a feeling, hold an event, or stop resisting
senses.example: The teacher gave us some useful advice.

senses.zh: 弹性；可弯曲或伸展的程度
senses.definition: the ability of a material to bend or stretch under pressure
senses.example: These shoes have enough give to be comfortable.

senses.definition: a large number of people or things
senses.example: How many books do you read each month?

senses.definition: a large number from a group already mentioned or understood
senses.example: Some guests left early, but many stayed.

senses.definition: in a good or successful way; fully; by a large amount
senses.example: She plays the piano very well.

senses.definition: healthy or in a good state
senses.example: I do not feel well today.

senses.definition: a deep hole in the ground used to obtain water, oil, or gas
senses.example: The village gets its water from a well.

senses.zh: 嗯；好吧（引出回应或思考）
senses.definition: used before speaking to show thought, doubt, surprise, or a change of subject
senses.example: Well, let me think about it.

senses.zh: 涌出、流出（常用 well up）
senses.definition: rise or flow out from inside, especially tears or a strong feeling
senses.example: Tears welled up in her eyes.

senses.definition: no more than the amount, person, thing, or situation mentioned
senses.example: I only need five minutes.

senses.definition: being the single person or thing of a particular kind
senses.example: This is the only key I have.

senses.definition: but, used to introduce a difficulty or reason not to do something
senses.example: I would come, only I have to work.

senses.definition: points to people or things farther away or already mentioned
senses.example: Those houses were built last year.

senses.definition: stands for people or things farther away or already mentioned
senses.example: Those are the shoes I want.

senses.zh: 告诉；讲述；吩咐；辨别；产生影响
senses.definition: give someone information, relate a story, give an order, recognise a difference, or have an effect
senses.example: Can you tell me how to get to the station?

senses.definition: to a high degree; used to make a description or a highest degree stronger
senses.example: The water is very cold.

senses.definition: exactly the person or thing mentioned, used for emphasis
senses.example: This is the very book I was looking for.

senses.definition: adds something surprising or makes a comparison stronger
senses.example: It was cold, even inside the house.

senses.zh: 平坦的；均匀的；相等的；偶数的
senses.definition: flat or smooth; regular or equal; divisible by two with nothing left over
senses.example: Spread the paint in an even layer.

senses.zh: 使平坦；使均等（常用 even out/up）
senses.definition: make something flat, smooth, or equal
senses.example: Use a knife to even out the top of the cake.
